title: Shop + Savor
slide_intent: Distinguish getting a task done from enjoying what it makes possible. People can recognize both reasons for using a service.
strategic_value: Instacart can connect the convenience of its product to the experiences that follow delivery.
demonstration: A horizontal arrow leads from efficiency to enjoyment. Large shop and savor specimens use contrasting letterforms, with a plus sign between them.
practical_value: Choose whether a communication primarily explains an efficient action or expresses the enjoyment it enables.

content_islands.name: Continuum
content_islands.spec: Place a thin arrow across the top and label its ends with efficiency and enjoyment.

content_islands.name: Paired words
content_islands.spec: Set shop and savor on one baseline with a plus sign. Give each a contrasting voice and place its explanation directly below.
